items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: Pete Ziefelt I think was playing piano, me and Emerson... there were six.

ctx.x: Oh, how neat. So there were six or seven people in the band at that time?

At that point we had, let’s see Pete Ziefelt I think was playing piano, me and Emerson, so that makes three, Larry Parker — yeah there were six. Larry and Mike Parker and Skooky Sherman. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
What did you call the music?
